scope: Single Coder-7B replica, one A100, eight active sequence slots, same diagnostic phase-counter binary. One replay client sees all foreground requests for this test. The history-only preview never blocks a ready real final answer. Use a single shared in-flight preview and the public 350ms, 1024-token thresholds.
schedule: Every fourth arrival is a short-context two-tool reader (2 notes, zero wait, no preview); the other three are long jobs (200 history entries, 96 notes, 500ms actual/hint for each tool). Submit jobs on a fixed 30ms grid. Interleave roles by index with the first a reader. New fixture seed per job. A public short chain warms each new server before the waves. All scenarios and policies submit identical scheduled inputs.
policies: off never previews. bounded uses one shared reservation, released as soon as the preview completes. headroom additionally skips if this client's foreground model requests currently in flight are at least six, preserving two of eight slots at the decision point. Client-side observations include waiting HTTP requests. Capture per-decision count, actual preview time, requests, metrics, and server steps. Never retry an error or omit a failed work item.
metrics: Measure first and last final content from scheduled arrival, final gap p95 per stream, basic valid answers and strict 90-word format separately, GPU execution summed over disjoint iterations, completed goodput per warmed GPU-hour from wave start through final drain including previews. SLO per job: basic valid, first final content within 5s, last final content within 8s, visible gap p95 at most 80ms. Record completed counts and client success even when SLO fails. Also report goodput including startup for the whole replay.
decision: Default promotion requires no loss of previously valid inputs, at least as many SLO completions, strictly greater combined warm SLO goodput in the two C16 waves on each device vs off, and reader scheduled-first p95 and p95 over reader stream gap p95 no worse than 1.05x off at C16. Compare to bounded especially where new pressure skips fired. Smaller waves descriptive. Failure retains opt-in status. Require actual eight-member GPU iterations to characterize slot saturation. Not a multi-node or steady-state capacity claim.
